Made of glossy Box calfskin, this Hermès Black Constance 23 is a vintage blast from the past! It’s paired with gold-tone hardware, most notably in the enamel H clasp that opens by lifting the center bar to reveal a black leather interior with one zipped and one slide pocket. Previously loved, stamped with an L in a circle, and just spa’d by Hermès in 2024, it has wear on the edges, inside, and hardware, chipping on the enamel, and needs an airing out. I think it’s safe to say this vintage bag has what it takes to become your Constance companion!
